949a884d-b348-5fa0-b1dd-adbebafe10a9.content: Use the same term throughout the proposal for the same interaction concept or interface element.

2f484151-b5fc-51a9-8a88-b30a403617b3.content: Use abbreviations only for recurring terms of three or more words.

21131a6f-d35c-51e3-895f-46cd21a3b566.content: Present the full name and abbreviation together when using an abbreviation for the first time.

e02c3110-05c4-58a4-8d76-c8fd2426a0d5.content: Prioritize the research role over diagnostic labels or deficits when referring to participants.

af028910-e48b-5605-b92b-9378bdfa525c.content: Reviewers from different subfields struggle to infer undefined abbreviations from context alone.

39792d18-2be0-5135-a063-c5213247d330.content: Use the term formative evaluation for studies seeking design modification evidence, and distinguish it from final efficacy judgments.

bcaa8c30-ca6e-5b9f-af93-88513a2f16b1.content: The agent can approve contribution labels such as principles, models, or guidelines only if they align with the abstraction level of the actual deliverables.

82ad9fe2-4063-5e89-9097-c975aa2920cb.content: Design principles describe the relationship between conditions and outcomes rather than serving as instructions that merely replicate a single screen layout.
